Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values

Class MandelaClosure

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values.MandelaClosure
All Implemented Interfaces:
Callable
public final class MandelaClosure extends Object implements Callable
A script function value: a compiled body plus the variables it closed over.

Two pieces of state travel together. upvalues() holds one Ref per captured variable — the same cell the defining frame writes to, which is why a closure sees later updates and can make them — and boundThis() is non-null only for a method taken off an instance, so obj.method produces a callable that still knows its receiver.

Closures are immutable. Binding this produces a new small object that shares the function and the upvalue array, so passing a method as a callback costs one allocation and no copying.

ownerClass() is the third piece, and it is only set for a method: the class that declared the body. super must be resolved from the declaring class rather than from the runtime class of the receiver, otherwise a three-level hierarchy re-enters the method it just tried to call up through. The machine reads it when it fills a method frame's slot 1.
